title: the_seed_that_remembers
beats: I've beaten this parkour seed 47 times, and every time, block 23 is missing a texture.
Not glitched. Missing. Like something scraped the skin off that one block.
Today I stopped on it instead of jumping past.
Chat started spamming 'don't look down' before I even moved my mouse.
I looked down anyway, and my own skin was standing in the void, waving up at me.
I've deleted the world three times now, and it keeps saving itself back.
If I finish the course tomorrow, can someone check if I'm still the one playing?
